profile.summary: A family-founded construction company based in Oakland, California, in business since 1947. It is a licensed general engineering contractor that does grading, underground utility work, street reconstruction, roadway widening, asphalt paving and pavement repair for public agencies in the Bay Area.

sources.title: Redgwick Construction | A Tradition of Excellence

review.notes: Company site (fetched directly; TLS chain incomplete) and the DBE Journal ad confirm Redgwick Construction Company at 21 Hegenberger Ct, Oakland, phone (510) 792-1727, with an OUSD project map matching the agenda titles (Sequoia, Crocker Highland, Calvin Simmons, Madison Primary, Cesar Chavez and Oakland HS turf). Summary matches the site's 1947 founding and services; 'family-founded' is a minor stretch since the company was sold out of the Redgwick family in 2005, but the founding family claim is accurate.
